tei:titleStmt.tei:title: אָדָם בְּקוּם עָלֵֽינוּ
Adam B'qum 'Alenu, a seliḥah for Taanit Esther by Menaḥem ben Makhir (ca. 11th c.)

tei:div.tei:head: Adam B'qum 'Alenu, a seliḥah for Taanit Esther by Menaḥem ben Makhir (ca. 11th c.)

tei:lg.tei:l: Our God and God of our ancestors...
As a man came against us, trembling seized us.
By hitching himself to a fickle reign, we almost tripped and fell.
Cheerfully they closed the deal on us, like a mound in a pit, none could help.

tei:l.tei:hi: They said, Come on, let’s destroy them as a people, so Israel’s name will no more be remembered.

tei:lg.tei:l: Do I lift my eyes on high to call You to curse my enemies!
Expunge their name and remnant, erase their name to rot!
Foe to my foes, deceive them the way they deceived to trip us!

tei:l.tei:hi: And they said, The CAUSE sees nothing, the God of Jacob does not understand.

tei:lg.tei:l: Grievously God tortured the poor ones, but did not seek to destroy them.
Heinously guilty they were, so by taking off a ring they were terrified.
Indeed God’s good word was fulfilled, to raise them up before the nations.

tei:l.tei:hi: In the land of their enemies I will not abandon nor despise them to destroy them.

tei:lg.tei:l: Just a preview of what would happen to the dirtied and palimpsested people.
Keep these words: “I will hide,” astir, and “pure myrrh,” mor dokh, how fragrant!
Letting Haman’s body fall, is it downha-min from the wooden pole?

tei:l.tei:hi: In place of the camelthorn will rise a cypress, in place of the nettle will rise a myrtle.

tei:lg.tei:l: Manipulated, the gullible one wrote accusation and sorrow.
Neatly wrapping himself in sacred garb as he mistook the end time.
Other vessels he ordered to use, tools of the House of the Quarry.

tei:l.tei:hi: And the Adversary too came among them to stand.

tei:lg.tei:l: People in Shushan ate the meat of their troublemaker.
Quantifying the price to give them over, he gaped his mouth to accuse them.
The Rock agreed to write a letter to end their hope.

tei:l.tei:hi: I said I would release them, release their moniker from humankind.

tei:lg.tei:l: Sanctified ministering angels bitterly wailed, crying:
Take heed of the covenant, Merciful One, and do not break or separate from it!
Upon hearing it, the Inheritance [Torah] wore sorrowful widows’ clothing.

tei:l.tei:hi: And she put her hand on her head and went, walking and crying.

tei:lg.tei:l: Vexed, the Tishbite wrapped sackcloth around his loins.
Whisking his way to let the three forefathers sleeping in Machpelah know.
Exploding to the Shepherd [Moses] — Why are you sleeping from considering?

tei:l.tei:hi: Get up! Call upon your God, who perhaps will consider us!

tei:lg.tei:l: Yet sealed in clay the matter was that he told to the Linguist [Mordechai].
Zealous anger of a decree they learned to overturn from Nineveh.
MENdicant-like, the son of Kish knocked on the schoolroom gates.

tei:l.tei:hi: And covered himself with sackclosh and sat on the ashes.

tei:lg.tei:l: ACcumulating children around him, three days the hidden ones fasted.
HE Might, by the voice of Jacob, weaken the hand of the RABBlerouser.
In faith he raised his hands to God: “Save us now from insults!
Lest he come and strike me, mother with children!” (Genesis 32:12
MAsters and teachers’ sons from here and from there
CHImed in cries, and their pleas went up to the CAUSE.
Receiving the shouts, the SOURCE asked:

tei:l.tei:hi: And what is this sound of sheep that is in My ears?

tei:lg.tei:l: SO Now, the Shepherd Lit up and answered: “The infants of the holy seed,
VEry soon to be executed by the wicked enemy. Save them, SOURCE!
As the Graceful One’s mercy was stirred, seeking to weep for the occurrence.

tei:l.tei:hi: And the Sovereign of Israel read the writ and tore it.

tei:lg.tei:l: Mordechai the Jew hanged children below and their father above.
Each man was three cubits, and the fourth exposed space.
Now that he saw a twofold vengeance, he rejoiced and meditated on praise:

tei:l.tei:hi: Me, I was returned to my post, and he was hanged!

tei:lg.tei:l: AND Esther wrote emphatically, to read as with a thanksgiving hallel.
Above established what the beloved ones accepted below.
MEN who bear witness shall raise a flag to make the wonder known again.

tei:l.tei:hi: At that time, tranquility and rescue will arise for the Jews!
